description: Read the full metadata and media list of one of your own software items by software_id. Works for all statuses (pending, approved, rejected). Returns { tool, media, missing_media, presentation } where media lists all uploaded screenshots/images with their ids and sizes, and presentation attests the listing level (incomplete, minimum, ideal) with toward_ideal, the steps left to the ideal presentation. Use this to verify current state after set_metadata, to get media ids before calling delete_media, or to read current metadata before an update. Requires sign-in to your Crela account; your client asks you to connect when you first use it.
name: get_my_software_details
title: Get details of own Crela software
